segments.name: Financial services
products: Checking, savings, and time deposit accounts
Real estate, commercial, industrial, residential and consumer loans
Private banking and wealth and asset management
Nonproprietary annuities and other insurance products
Small balance unsecured loans and secured loans
segments.description: A financial holding company providing full-service banking, lending, wealth management and related financial services to individual, business, governmental and institutional customers.
segments.evidence: The Bank is a full-service bank engaging in a full range of banking activities and services for individual, business, governmental and institutional customers.

revenueModel.text: The company earns interest income on loans and investments under contract, plus fees from deposit service charges, wealth and asset management, and card interchange from its customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The largest source of revenue for the Corporation is interest income, which is primarily recognized on an accrual basis according to a written contract, such as loan and lease agreements or investment securities contracts.

changes.text: In 2025, the Corporation acquired ESSA Bancorp, Inc. and its subsidiary ESSA Bank & Trust Company, extending CNB Bank's branch network into Northeastern Pennsylvania.
changes.evidence: On July 23, 2025, the Corporation completed its previously announced acquisition of ESSA Bancorp, Inc. ("ESSA") and its subsidiary bank, ESSA Bank & Trust Company ("ESSA Bank"), pursuant to the definitive merger agreement (the "Merger Agreement") dated as of January 9, 2025.
